What awful service. Better staff training needed!!
Jun 2020 • Family
I have always been impressed with the service and quality of food at Pauls in Bangkok and Singapore. So when we decided to choose Paul for a meal today, we had expected the same level of professional service that we have been used to. Imagine our disappointment when we were told, sorry, we cant provide you with 4 glasses because we only ordered a bottle of water! The fact we ordered 5 dishes had made no difference!! Sorry Paul Vietnam. Never again. We decided not to order the 3 desserts and a latte we had wanted to order. For fun, I told the waiter, since I ordered 5 dishes, I should have 5 place settings. He obliged by providing 5 forks!! Haha.

French Experience in Vietnam

Poor service, food average
Oct 2019 • Friends
We came in a group of three. My friend already got us a table. When two of us came in and we told the staff that we already got a table but they seemed not to understand. There were three of us but they brought out ONE menu, we had to take turn to use the menu. We sat inside and at the corner, staff stood in the front, it was difficult to call staff to order. No water was available, they sell mineral water. That's fine. We ordered a bottle, they brought out two glasses of ice, we asked for an extra glass of ice (because we came in three), the staff refused and said they would charge us extra 10,000 vnd for the extra glass. Ridiculous! Food came out after 45 minutes since we ordered at our table. One dish came first, our friend finished it and the other two came out. The quality of the food is average compared to the price. Never again! And would not recommend this place for my friends

Seems average and I worry about transparency
Oct 2019
This account is created today, and my experience is of course entirely subjective. But the drink I ordered today seemed really average, especially for the listed price. I was not so happy to see service charge printed on the bill. The amount of that charge was negligible, but the problem was... it was not mentioned anywhere on the menu. I had to double check and triple check to make sure I was not paranoid. Most restaurant these days state clearly whether taxes and other fees are included in the price or not. I explained this to a staff, and all I got was blank stare. It is fair to say I will not come back again.
